has a non-zero solution (x, y, z), then is equal to
en.explanation:
System of equations has non-zero solution when determinant of coefficient = 0.

So, in this questions,



( 3K + 8) K (9 + 4) + 3(12 2K) = 0

3K + 8 + 9K 4K + 36 6K = 0

4K + 44 = 0

K = 11

Now the equations become

x + 11y + 3z = 0 . . . (1)

3x + 11y 2z = 0 . . . (2)

2x + 4y 3z = 0 . . . (3)

By adding equation (1) and (3) we get,

3x + 15y = 0

x = 5y

Putting x = 5y in equation (1) we get

5y + 11y + 3z = 0

6y + 3z = 0

z = 2y
